_doc: Candidate-finder rules for ap_lint.py. They point the agent at likely problems; they are heuristics, not verdicts. Fields: id, lang (en|zh|any), pattern (Python regex, case-insensitive unless 'case': true), category (= change type to use if you fix it), message, hint. Rules with 'residual': true are re-run on the revised text by ap_build.py and reported as warnings if still present. 'genres' limits a rule to some genres (journal, thesis, grant, response, abstract); empty = all.

rules.hint: write the full form (do not, cannot, it is)

rules.pattern: \b(?:a lot of|lots of|a bunch of|kind of|sort of|pretty much|really|stuff|things like|huge|tons of|got|gets|getting|big deal|okay|ok)\b
rules.hint: use a precise academic equivalent (many / considerable / substantially) without changing the amount claimed

rules.pattern: \b(?:more and more|with the (?:rapid )?development of|plays? an? (?:important|vital|key|crucial) role|so as to|in order to|has been widely (?:used|applied)|has attracted (?:more and more|increasing|much) attention|make (?:\w+ ){0,3}more \w+|according to the (?:results|above)|and so on|as we all know|it is well known that|it is worth noting that|it should be noted that|nowadays)\b
rules.hint: rephrase concisely; keep the claim and its strength
research / information / equipment / evidence / software / data / knowledge

rules.pattern: \b(?:despite of|associated to|risk factor of|correlated to|similar with|different with|discuss about|emphasi[sz]e on|research on (?:the )?\w+ (?:is|are)|according to (?:my|our) knowledge|comprise of|consist in of|compared to with|in the other hand|on the contrary to)\b
rules.hint: despite / discuss / emphasise / to our knowledge / comprise (or consist of) / on the other hand
drop 'etc.'
delete the duplicate
'an' if the word starts with a vowel sound
'a' unless the word is an acronym read letter by letter (an SEM, an MRI)
these/those + plural, or singular noun
use the plural noun
are / were / have / show (keep 'data is' only if the style guide allows it)
is / was / has / shows

rules.pattern: \b(?:obviously|clearly|undoubtedly|of course|needless to say|it is evident that)\b
rules.hint: remove or soften only if the source evidence does not support certainty; record the change - removing a booster weakens the claim
use neutral wording; do not change the measured result
use 'we' or the passive, following the target style

rules.message: missing space between number and unit (SI style)
rules.hint: 10 nm, 5 mg (no space for %, °)
e.g., i.e., et al., etc.

rules.message: space before punctuation or missing space after it
rules.hint: one space after , ; : and none before
half-width , . ; : ? ! ( )
keep it if it carries meaning; never replace by a stronger claim

rules.pattern: \b(?:in this paper|in this study|in this work), (?:we|the authors) (?:will )?(?:make|do|carry out|conduct|perform) (?:a|an|the)? ?(?:study|research|analysis|investigation)\b
rules.hint: use the verb ('we analyse')
'X shows that ...' / 'As shown in Fig. N, ...'
en dash (10–20 nm) per most journal styles; do not change the numbers
keep only connectives that mark a real logical relation

rules.pattern: 很多|非常|特别|搞|弄|啥|咱们|我觉得|我认为|大家|挺|蛮|超级|一大堆
rules.hint: 改为书面语（大量、显著、本文认为）；不改变数量或强度

rules.pattern: 国际领先|国内领先|世界一流|填补.{0,6}空白|重大突破|突破性|革命性|颠覆性|完美|前所未有|首创|全新
rules.hint: 改为中性描述；若为基金申请书中的创新性陈述，保留事实部分并标注需人工确认

rules.pattern: 绝对|完全解决|彻底解决|必然|一定能|毫无疑问|100%
rules.hint: 仅在材料支持时保留；修改会削弱结论，需记录

rules.pattern: ^\s*(?:通过|经过|随着|在|由于|对于|关于)[^，。]{2,40}，?(?:使|使得|让|表明|说明|发现)
rules.message: 介词结构开头导致主语缺失（"通过……使……"）
rules.hint: 删去介词或补出主语

rules.pattern: (?:进行|开展|做)了?(?:一系列|大量|深入|系统|详细|初步)?的?(?:研究|分析|讨论|测试|表征|比较|计算|实验|观察|测量|处理|优化|改进|评价|评估|检测|统计|调查|模拟)
rules.message: 冗余名词化（"进行了分析"）
rules.hint: 直接用动词（"分析了"）
删去重复

rules.message: 中文语境使用半角标点
rules.hint: 改为全角，。；：？！

rules.pattern: 随着.{1,20}的(?:快速|迅速|不断)?发展|越来越多的|起着?(?:重要|关键|至关重要)的?作用|引起了?(?:广泛|越来越多的|人们的)关注
rules.hint: 改为具体陈述或删去

rules.message: 两面对一面（"是否……是关键"）
rules.hint: 前后都用两面词或都用一面词
保留一个概数词；不改数值
删除空格
改为“”或‘’
必要时改为主动句
single space
do not guess the text: mark the sentence in needs_confirmation

rules.message: 'a' before an acronym read with a vowel sound (a HTL, a SEM)?
rules.hint: 'an HTL', 'an SEM' (letter names starting with a vowel sound)

rules.message: 学位论文/期刊中文稿使用第一人称
rules.hint: 学位论文通常用“本文”“本研究”；按目标文体决定

rules.pattern: 从图中可以看出|从表中可以看出|由此可以看出|可以看出|不难看出|众所周知
rules.hint: “由图N可见”“图N表明”；补出具体图表号

rules.message: 'Where' after a display equation usually continues the sentence
rules.hint: lower-case 'where' (no paragraph break before it)
However, / In addition, / Therefore, - keep the logical relation

rules.message: 'which' referring to the preceding clause takes a singular verb
rules.hint: which suggests / which indicates

rules.message: singular abbreviation with plural verb (PSC are)?
rules.hint: plural abbreviation (PSCs are) or singular verb
